ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across the visible surface with a high contrast ratio relative to the surrounding water; >95% of the visible fluke surface consists of dark pixels with localized specular highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across the entire visible ventral plane; localized high-intensity pixel clusters (specular glare) are mapped along the central ridge and right-side trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a wide obtuse angle; depth is approximately 10-15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks along the continuous boundary; more pronounced jaggedness observed on the inner-half of the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into an acute upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to dense barnacle colonies.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme accumulation of high-contrast textured masses (barnacles) at both distal tips; irregular micro-notching visible along the right trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward vertical orientation of the lobe tips relative to the horizontal plane of the fluke body.
